_readme: Hand-maintained price overrides, keyed by template id. Prices are set in EUR, the site currency, so the entry-level tiers land on exactly 5/10/15/20/25; the backend converts to the base currency when charging (templateCatalog.service.ts), so no other code needs to know. Shape: { "<id>": { "price": number, "currency": "EUR" } } — a currency that isSupportedCurrency() rejects is ignored and the imported price is kept. Only lower a price here: raising one above the imported catalog price would misprice a product.
